summary:
Frontend-only test of ABENA chat widget presentation on PREVIEW (3 real /api/chat calls). All requested features PASS: EN welcome (en-US) and FR welcome (fr-FR) match spec exactly, contain no price/delay, and **ABENA** renders as (no literal **). FR multi-question reply rendered as Markdown: 3

, 1

    with 5
  • , no literal '**' or '- ' bullets, internal links /track and /prices rendered as (no target). Prices/delays question on mobile returned 2 lists + 7 + /apply link. Clicking internal link navigated via react-router (window marker preserved = no full reload), chat window stayed open and input usable. Mobile 390x844: window x=8,w=374 (inset-x-2), bottom 764 < launcher top 770 so no overlap; elementFromPoint at input/send centers hits the input/send themselves (not blocked by WhatsApp button); no horizontal overflow; messages list scrolls (scrollTop changes); close works. Escalation 'Je veux parler à un humain' -> abena-escalated-badge 'TRANSMIS À UN CONSEILLER · TICKET 5AC19AC4' + abena-contact-form with name/email/done; OK hides form. Desktop 1920x800 home and /apply render normally, no page errors.

integration_issues.issue: Name/email entered in abena-contact-form are only sent with the NEXT /api/chat message; clicking 'OK' just hides the form. If the visitor fills email and leaves, the already-created ticket never receives the contact email.

issues: Minor: window max-h 600px leaves ~160px empty band above window on 844px screens (fine, cosmetic).
Flag emoji 🇬🇭 renders as letters 'GH' on Windows desktops (OS limitation, cosmetic).

action_items: Optional: on abena-contact-done, PATCH/POST contact name/email to the existing escalated ticket (or send immediately) so email isn't lost if user sends no further message.
critical_code_review_comments: AbenaMessage.jsx: skipHtml set, img/hr dropped, links whitelisted (relative '/' but not '//' -> Link; https/mailto/tel -> new tab with noopener; anything else incl. javascript: -> plain <span>). XSS-safe by review.
abenaLang(): html lang 'en' falls back to navigator.language -> works; if site later sets <html lang> from a language switcher it will take precedence as intended.
AbenaChat.jsx scroll effect runs on [messages, open, busy]; scrollIntoView smooth on latest AI reply works. No issues.

Content note (not presentation): AI reply stated 'nous n'acceptons actuellement pas les cartes Visa ... USDT (TRC20 et BEP20)' — confirm this matches current admin payment settings (payments not touched in this test).
seed_data_creation: Escalation test created one support ticket/chat session in preview DB (ticket id prefix 5ac19ac4, contact not submitted). No other data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use browser.new_context(locale='fr-FR') for FR welcome. Cookie banner: click 'Reject non-essential'. Chat calls are real Claude; 3 used this run. Screenshots in /app/.screenshots (mobile_fr.jpg, m_reply.jpg, m_esc.jpg).
